answer: A farm cannot pad a short template to fit, because the duplicate check runs on the padded text and the vault band is published for each class. The length band is a cap tied to the mechanism class, 195 to 394 characters here, and an answer outside it is rejected as padded or truncated before the orchard identity is graded at all. Since the measured length is checked against the declared class, the relic audit records the value and keeps the rejection reason. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
